questions.question: Why is shrinking the left edge safe when looking for the longest window without repeats?

questions.question: Why is comparing each node only with its direct children not enough to validate a BST?

questions.question: How do you separate BFS output into levels?

questions.question: In a BST, the lowest common ancestor of a and b is…

questions.question: Why is the monotonic-stack next-greater algorithm O(n) despite a nested while?

options.a: Each index is pushed and popped at most once

questions.explain: The total work of all inner loops is bounded by n pops.

questions.question: When is an element's answer known in a next-greater scan?

options.b: When a later, larger element pops it

questions.explain: The popping element is exactly its next greater.

questions.question: The sliding-window maximum uses a deque rather than a stack because…

options.a: old elements expire from the front

questions.question: Why does postorder avoid repeated work for subtree properties?

questions.question: Inorder traversal of a BST yields…

questions.question: Looking up a word of length L in a trie costs…

options.a: DFS visiting children in sorted order

questions.question: What makes backtracking correct when state is shared?
